entries.wording: 货物电子信息已经收到
entries.note: The Hualei platform's own row on the order's creation time: the shipment data has arrived.

entries.wording: 已入库,到达收货点
entries.note: Booked into the warehouse at the receiving point.

entries.wording: 已出库,货物离开操作中心
entries.note: Booked out: the parcel has left the operations centre.

entries.wording: 国内清关中
entries.note: Export customs clearance in China is under way.

entries.wording: 已排航班
entries.note: A flight has been booked.

entries.wording: 货物已交机场
entries.english: The goods have been delivered to the airport
entries.note: The step the airport rows lead with, before the flight's day and an English translation. It is not a delivery to the recipient, though the translation reads 'delivered'. The English is the tracker's own for the step.

entries.wording: 货物已交机场，等待安排航班中The goods have been delivered to the airport and are awaiting the arrangement of flights.
entries.note: Handed to the airport to wait for a flight. It is not a delivery to the recipient, though a translation may read 'Delivered'.

entries.wording: 货物已交机场，预计6号的航班The goods have been delivered to the airport. The flight is scheduled for the 6th.
entries.note: Handed to the airport, with the day of the flight booked.

entries.wording: 航班延误
entries.note: The step a delay row leads with: the flight is late and the parcel waits for the next one. The English is a plain rendering.

entries.wording: 航班延误，预计7号的航班Flight delay. The flight scheduled for the 7th is expected to be delayed.
entries.note: The flight is delayed to the day it names.

entries.wording: 头程起飞
entries.note: The step the first flight's departure leads with. The English is a plain rendering.

entries.wording: 头程起飞，预计8号落地The flight departs at the beginning and is expected to land on the 8th.
entries.note: The first flight has left, with the day it should land.

entries.wording: 头程落地
entries.note: The step the first flight's landing leads with. The English is the tracker's own for the step.

entries.wording: 头程落地，二程预计8号的航班The first leg has arrived. The second leg is expected to depart on the 8th.
entries.note: The first flight has landed and the connecting one is booked.

entries.wording: 二程起飞
entries.note: The step the connecting flight's departure leads with. The English is a plain rendering.

entries.wording: 二程起飞，预计9号落地Flight 202 is taking off and is expected to land on the 9th.
entries.note: The connecting flight has left. The translation reads the second leg (二程) as a flight number.

entries.wording: 航班落地
entries.note: The step the landing in the destination region leads with.

entries.wording: 航班落地，拆板清关The flight landed, and the board was dismantled and cleared
entries.note: Landed; the pallets are broken down for import clearance, which is under way.

entries.wording: 起运地航班起飞
entries.note: The flight has left the origin.

entries.wording: 已到达目的国
entries.note: Arrived in the destination country or region.

entries.wording: 清关完成
entries.note: Customs cleared the parcel, which carries on.

entries.wording: 清关完成，待转运Clearance has been completed and it is awaiting transfer.
entries.note: Cleared at the destination and waiting to be handed to the delivering carrier.

entries.wording: 已转运transferred
entries.note: Handed to the delivering carrier, whose number the tracker then shows.

entries.wording: The instruction data for this shipment have been provided by the sender to DHL electronically
entries.note: Relayed from DHL: the label's data, on the day the order was created.

entries.wording: The international shipment has been processed in the parcel center of origin
entries.note: Relayed from DHL in Germany after the hand-off.

entries.wording: The international shipment has been processed in the export parcel center
entries.note: Relayed from DHL in Germany.

entries.wording: The shipment has arrived in the destination country/destination area.
entries.note: Relayed from DHL, followed by the destination operator's tracking link in brackets; the map reads the wording without the link.

entries.wording: The shipment has been loaded onto the delivery vehicle
entries.note: The last-mile carrier's delivery run, in Mayi Yinfu's English.

entries.wording: The shipment has been successfully delivered
